name: @claude-flow/plugin-banking-personas
description: Skeleton banking-personas plugin pack: illustrative calibrated agents for SR 11-7 / NIST AI 600-1 / EU AI Act workflows. Each persona is a CalibratedAgent registered through OrchestratorAgentProtocol so it runs inside any orchestration framework (ruflo / langgraph / crewai / autogen). NOT production — counsel-gated until petition framing locks (see RUFLO_AS_CORE_IMPACT §4.3).
author: Rafael Martins Alves

personas.name: bcb_compliance_officer
personas.description: Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) Resolution 4.658 / 4.893 compliance reviewer. Calibrated with semantic_entropy + p_true threshold gating.

personas.name: mrm_validator
personas.description: SR 11-7 model-risk-management validator. Triages findings by conceptual soundness / outcome analysis / ongoing monitoring pillar.

personas.name: basel_iii_reporter
personas.description: Basel III Pillar 3 disclosure drafter. Calibrated with semantic_entropy; refuses to draft below threshold.

personas.name: finqa_analyst
personas.description: Multi-hop financial-QA analyst. Uses self_consistency + verbalized confidence; cites paragraph IDs from source 10-K.

personas.name: credit_memo_drafter
personas.description: Credit memo first-pass drafter for German / Australian credit datasets. Conformal-prediction gated.

personas.name: kyc_narrative_writer
personas.description: Know-Your-Customer narrative drafter. Refuses on low confidence and surfaces the reason for human review.

personas.name: aml_summarizer
personas.description: Anti-Money-Laundering pattern summarizer. claim_level uncertainty so every sub-claim is gated independently.

personas.name: regime_crosswalk_agent
personas.description: Cross-regime regulatory mapper. Given a metric, returns the controls it satisfies across NIST AI 600-1 / EU AI Act / BCBS 239 / BCB Res. 4.893 / ISO 23894 / ISO 42001.

personas.name: drift_detector
personas.description: Calibration drift watcher. Flags when ECE or PSI crosses a runtime-enforced gate.

personas.name: challenge_generator
personas.description: Adversarial / challenge-prompt generator. Drives the CEC replay engine.

notes: These manifests are declarative; the actual CalibratedAgent classes live in handlers.py.
All ten personas are calibrated workers — the orchestration runtime is the user's choice (ruflo / langgraph / crewai / autogen).
Per RUFLO_VS_LUB_GAP §4.3, full implementation is post-filing v0.4+; this skeleton is the contract surface only.
